title: Trust anchor pre-flight and revocation ordering is correct
description: validate_chain() correctly orders operations: (1) check trust_anchors non-empty, (2) build chain via DN matching, (3) bridge to pkix-chain and verify signatures/validity via pkix-chain::verify_chain_default with NoRevocation, (4) then run caller's revocation checker on the signature-verified chain. Running revocation AFTER signature verification is correct — you should not trust revocation responses from certs whose signatures you haven't verified.
